hero.name: Salomon Kabongo
hero.lede: Ndi ngenza recherche bua kumanya mushindu udi ba machine bilonga muakulu — ne ndi ngulongesha bualu ebu mu Anglais, Français, Lingala ne Tshiluba.
hero.description: Mudimu wanyi udi pankatshi pa malu abidi adi kaayi asambakena misangu ya bungi to: recherche wa NLP udi ba expert bamone, ne kutuadila dimanya edi kudi bantu badi kabayi bafunda bua bobo. Ndi nteka technologie wa muakulu bua miakulu ya Afrika, ndi nenza AI appliquée mu ba entreprise, ne ndi ngumvuija yonso ibidi ku YouTube.
hero.now_role: Lead Software Engineer, Innovation Group wa State Farm
hero.now_phd: PhD mu Informatique, Leibniz Universität Hannover
hero.now_masakhane: Ancien membre wa conseil, Masakhane Research Foundation

about.title: Technologie wa muakulu bua bantu badi bapua muoyo misangu ya bungi
about.bio1: Ndi ne doctorat (PhD) mu Informatique ku Leibniz Universität Hannover, muaba uvua recherche wanyi utangila traitement wa muakulu naturel (NLP), extraction wa malu ne graphe ya dimanya — nangananga, mushindu wa kupatula ku bungi ba résultat structuré ne comparable munkatshi mua littérature scientifique.
about.bio2: Mu Innovation Group wa State Farm ndi nlombola recherche appliquée mu computer vision, intelligence documentaire ne AI générative — mudimu udi mupatule brevet umue wa AI/ML ne ba dépôt isatu mikuabo. Mu conseil wa Masakhane Research Foundation, ngakambuluisha programme wa kupita 9M$ bua kuteka infrastructure NLP ouverte bua kupita milliard umue wa bantu badi bakula miakulu ya Afrika.
about.bio3: Recherche ne dilongesha bidi projet umue. Article udi uya anu kudi bantu badi babala Anglais kabidi udi article udi kayi mujikije mudimu wende to — ke bualu kayi ndi ngulongesha mu Anglais, Français, Lingala ne Tshiluba.
research_items: Traitement wa muakulu naturel (NLP) ne Large Language Models
Reconnaissance ne traduction ya mêyi bua miakulu idi ne ba ressource mikese
Graphe ya dimanya ne extraction wa malu a scientifique
about.darakili: Dilaya edi ke didi dinenza bua nenze mudimu ku DarAkili, plateforme wa éducation STEM muaba badi ba professionnel ba Afrika bapatula ba minicours ya ofele mu miakulu yabu.

speaking.home_title: Baconférence, malongesha ne ba table ronde
speaking.home_subtitle: Ndi ngakula kumpala kua ba chercheur ne kumpala kua bantu bonso, mu Anglais anyi mu Français, bua recherche wa AI, technologie wa miakulu ya Afrika, ne tshidi tshikengela bua kuteka yonso ibidi.
speaking.title: Baconférence
speaking.subtitle: Ndi ngakula ku ba université, ba groupe ya recherche, baconférence ne ba entreprise — mu Anglais anyi Français, ku ligne anyi ku présentiel.
speaking.topic_1_title: Muaba udi ba grand modèle ya muakulu bapona bushuwa
speaking.topic_1_desc: Muyuki wa chercheur udi wenza mudimu bua tshidi ba système ba lelu benza bimpe, muaba udi bipona, ne mushindu wa kumanya dishilangana — bua public technique, kakuyi kulomba expertise wa NLP.
speaking.topic_2_desc: Bualu kayi kupita milliard umue wa bantu kabatu bapeta technologie wa muakulu to, tshidi Masakhane ne communauté bateke, ne njila wa bushuwa udi kumpala.
speaking.topic_3_title: Kufuma ku recherche kufika ku production
speaking.topic_3_desc: Kutuadila machine learning kufuma ku article kufika ku système udi muenze ne mupete brevet munkatshi mua organisation munene — ne ba compromis adi muntu kayi ufunda to.
speaking.topic_4_title: Kuteka carrière wa recherche kufuma ku luseke
speaking.topic_4_desc: Bua ba étudiant ne ba chercheur bapiapia badi pambelu pa njila wa tshibidilu: mushindu wa kukeba ba collaborateur, kupatula ba article, ne kuitabujibua.
speaking.invite_body: Ngambila bua public webe, dituku ne format. Ndi nandamuna ku demande yonso, ne ndi nsanka bua kulongolola conférence bilondeshile tshidi groupe webe wenza.

consulting.title: Conseil ne accompagnement
consulting.subtitle: Accompagnement wa pa nkayadi bua ba équipe badi bateka ne ba modèle ya muakulu, AI documentaire, anyi technologie wa miakulu ya Afrika.
consulting.area_1_title: Ba système NLP ne LLM appliqués
consulting.area_1_desc: Ba revue ya architecture, conception wa évaluation, ne mibelu ya bushuwa bua kumanya bikala modèle wa muakulu udi menemene outil udi ukumbana ne problème udi kumpala kuebe.
consulting.area_2_desc: Ba pipeline ya extraction, classification ne dimvua bua ba document ba bushuwa badi complexe — domaine wa mudimu wanyi wa brevet.
consulting.area_3_desc: Stratégie wa ba donnée, bulunda ne communauté ne disungula dia ba modèle bua ba équipe badi bateka bintu bua ba marché ya Afrika ne ba utilisateur ba miakulu ya bungi.
consulting.area_4_desc: Bua ba laboratoire ne ba fondation: direction wa recherche, stratégie wa publication, ne kuteka ba collaboration adi ashala kupita cycle wa kumpala wa financement.
consulting.format_1_desc: Appel umue bua kutentekesha dipangadika. Misangu ya bungi bidi bikumbana.
consulting.format_2_desc: Ditangila dia système, dia ba donnée anyi dia plan wa recherche, dipeshibue bu évaluation mufunda.
consulting.format_3_desc: Mudimu udi upingana ne équipe mu trimestre anyi kupita.
consulting.cta_body: Appel wa kumpala udi wa ofele ne kena ne bualu bukuabo anu bua kumanya bikala ndi mua kukuambuluisha bushuwa. Bikala meme ki muntu udi ukumbana to, nenkuambile ne nenkuleje muntu mukuabo.
